# endpointcentral_script (Data Source)

Looks up a script in the Script Repository by file name, for `endpointcentral_mac_custom_script`. Scripts cannot be uploaded through the API (the console's calls refuse OAuth tokens); add them in the console. A script's default arguments are not exposed: they may hold secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "endpointcentral_script" "computer_name" {
  name = "set-computer-name.sh"
}

data "endpointcentral_script" "linux_setup" {
  name     = "linux-setup.sh"
  platform = "linux"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact file name, e.g. `set-computer-name.sh`.

### Optional

- `platform` (String) `mac` (default), `linux` or `windows`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `exit_codes` (String) Exit codes that count as success, as entered in the repository.
- `id` (String) Script ID.
